### Day Sixty-One
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/whispers-of-hope-10-weeks-of-devotional-praye/whispers-of-hope-10-weeks-of-devotional-prayer-woh04-content-60.html
Passage: 2 Kings 2:11
Points:
- Spiritual mentors are divine gifts, but their true purpose is discipleship rather than unhealthy dependency.
- Elisha struggled deeply with grief and anxiety over Elijah's imminent departure.
- God often allows separation from human mentors so we learn to know Him directly for ourselves.
- Believers still retain the spiritual mantle of wisdom, memories, and faithfulness left behind by mentors.
